summary: Opt-in daemon-local admission for a trusted API readiness reading and one native fault per missed objective episode

replay.detail: Existing claims and projections are unchanged. An enabled member persists one admitted pending cut and replays it before accepting a successor after restart.

schema.detail: No SQL, client wire or claim schema change.

rules.detail: Uses existing system-only claims. The new readiness fault condition prevents fallback assignment when the explicit reviewer stops or retires. Other faults retain their routing rules.

compatibility.detail: An enabled member adds a native API readiness objective. Builds that predate readiness_slo reject that optional config key; absent the key behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No added downtime on upgrade. Enabling or removing the policy uses the usual daemon restart.

manual.detail: Off by default. Upgrade every fault reader before enabling to preserve owner-only routing. Install the trusted publisher, select exactly one executor, monitored member and declared reviewer in readiness_slo, and validate the source and receiver in isolation.

recovery.detail: Remove readiness_slo from the daemon configuration before rolling back. Existing open native faults remain available to the reviewer. Keep the admitted-cut checkpoint while re-enabling the same policy.
